command.description: The command to execute on all target hosts.

hosts.description: A list of hosts (user@host or host) to connect to.

identity.description: Path to the SSH identity file (private key).

ssh_opts.description: List of SSH options to pass via -o. e.g., StrictHostKeyChecking=no

timeout.description: Timeout setting for each session in seconds.

remote_shell.description: Path to the shell on the remote host.

login.description: Login username to use when no user@host is specified.

quiet.description: No output unless necessary. Overrides -d and -v.

max_parallel.description: Max hosts to run concurrently. 0 for infinite.

force_agent.description: Force loading ssh-agent even if one is already loaded.

disable_agent.description: Do NOT load ssh-agent. Prompt for password/passphrase.

block_output.description: Print each host's output in a block without mingling.

duplicate_hosts.description: Do NOT make the host list unique. Execute on duplicates.

no_password.description: Do NOT fall back to passwords on any host.

proxy_host.description: Host to use as a proxy (bastion host). Format: [user@]host.

proxy_ssh_opts.description: List of SSH options to pass to the proxy via -po.
